title: Tsugumomo
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kazuya Kagami learns that the obi his late mother gave him has become Kiriha, a tsukumogami (an object with a soul). After she saves him from an amasogi, a spirit born of impure wishes, he works as an exorcist for the local land god Kukuri, gathers more tsukumogami partners, and uncovers a hidden, dark past tied to his mother.
life_message: Bonds with those who share your life, people and objects alike, give strength to face a painful past.
